title.zh: Codex CLI 0.171.0：终端工作区默认打开，非交互任务也能连远程
title.en: Codex CLI 0.171.0: terminal workspace on by default, and non-interactive tasks can attach remotely

summary.zh: Codex CLI 0.171.0 让预览文档、图片和子代理 transcript 可以留在终端会话旁，并支持用 codex exec --remote 在已有的 app server 上启动或恢复非交互会话。GPT-6.2 Sol 和 Astra 同时加入模型目录，默认选 Sol。这里的远程是连接一个已经运行的服务，不会自动开机器。GPT-6.2 的发布已在 11 月 18 日记录，这里只记 CLI 的远程入口与目录更新。同一窗口 Antigravity 桌面端的 SSH 是另一条事件。
summary.en: Codex CLI 0.171.0 keeps previews of documents, images, and sub-agent transcripts beside the terminal session, and adds codex exec --remote to start or resume a non-interactive session on an already running app server. GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra also joined the model catalog, with Sol as the default. Remote here means attaching to a service that is already running; it does not provision a machine. The GPT-6.2 launch was already recorded on 18 November; this leaf is the CLI remote entry and catalog update. Antigravity's desktop SSH in the same window is a separate event.

brief.zh: Codex CLI 0.171.0 默认打开终端工作区，并可用已有 app server 运行非交互远程任务。GPT-6.2 Sol 与 Astra 进入模型目录。
brief.en: Codex CLI 0.171.0 opens a terminal workspace by default and can run non-interactive remote tasks on an existing app server. GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra joined the model catalog.

why.zh: 交互式会话和脚本任务都有了连接远程会话服务的入口，这比再开一个窗口更值得记下。
why.en: Both interactive sessions and scripted tasks now have a way to attach to a remote session service, which is more than another window.
